subject: Mutual Action Plan — SIG/CAIQ matrix, DPA scope & retention carveouts
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP and evidence ask (SIG/CAIQ + DPA retention carveouts)

Team —

I pulled together a short Mutual Action Plan for FinStream focused on the security gates they flagged in the last call: SIG/CAIQ evidence, SOC 2 cadence for the onboarding sprint, DPA redlines (esp. retention carveouts) and data residency questions. Initial artifacts attached: sig-caiq-gap-matrix.xlsx and redwood-dpa-draft-v3.pdf.

Goal: get to a MAP that the FinStream legal + security teams can sign off on by mid-December so product can be staged in their UAT window.

Key asks from us (owners noted):
- Complete SIG/CAIQ evidence map (kimberly) — list of items we can produce vs. mitigations for gaps (due EOD 11/18).
- Confirm SOC 2 report availability and timebox for evidence sprint (jonas) — SOC 2 Type II latest 2026-08 report; need to note any controls that need additional context.
- Draft DPA redline with retention carveouts (marcus) — propose default retention and carveouts for logs, embeddings, and customer-supplied PII (due 11/18).

Risks to call out: FinStream wants shorter retention on logs/embeddings (they proposed 90 days); legal prefers 180 days. We should surface cost/ops tradeoffs for <90d in Hosted vs Dedicated.

Plan to send a consolidated MAP + ask email to FinStream later today after we have the gap matrix filled. Please add comments to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-finstream-mpa

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finstream.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & close cadence — SIG/CAIQ, SOC 2 evidence, DPA retention options

Marta —

Great to speak this morning. Attached is a concise Mutual Action Plan that lays out the gates and owners for the next 4–6 weeks. High-level summary:

What we included:
- SIG/CAIQ gap matrix (we flagged items we can provide immediately vs. items requiring mitigations).
- SOC 2 evidence runway (we can provide the latest Type II report and targeted control narratives).
- Draft DPA with proposed retention carveouts for logs, embeddings, and customer-uploaded data.

Two quick clarifications we want to align on up front:
1) Retention windows: you noted legal prefers 90 days for embeddings/logs; our standard hosted plan defaults to 180 days for logs and 365 for embeddings unless a carveout is negotiated. Shorter windows reduce traceability for debugging and could change SLA commitments — we want to map the operational impact.
2) SIG/CAIQ evidence: we can deliver control artifacts for 85% of the table within the week; the remaining items require product/engineering ownership (KV cache handling, third-party dependency attestations).

Proposed immediate milestones (feel free to push dates):
- 11/18 — Redwood delivers completed SIG/CAIQ matrix + redline DPA v3 (action: kimberly, marcus).
- 11/24 — FinStream provides prioritized retention target and legal comments on DPA.
- 12/01 — Joint evidence sprint kickoff (live sessions) to close outstanding SIG items.
- 12/15 — Target DPA sign & MAP acceptance for go/no-go staging.

Attachments: sig-caiq-gap-matrix.xlsx, redwood-dpa-draft-v3.pdf

Can you confirm the retention target FinStream legal is aiming for (90d vs 180d) and whether your team needs a separate EU-residency clause? We can propose a carveout that keeps embeddings at 90 days by default with an option for longer retention under Dedicated capacity.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0147
[Attachment: sig-caiq-gap-matrix.xlsx] [Attachment: redwood-dpa-draft-v3.pdf]
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finstream.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@finstream.com>, legal@finstream.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & close cadence — SIG/CAIQ, SOC 2 evidence, DPA retention options

Tessa —

Thanks for the clear MAP and the attachments. A few quick items from legal/security after a fast sync this morning:

- Retention: legal is pushing for 90 days for logs and embeddings as their standard. They are open to 180d for logs if we can add stronger deletion attestations and a third-party escrow for critical audit trails.
- Embeddings: security asked whether embeddings can be pseudonymized/hashed for downstream storage — is that part of the hosted offering or would that require us deploying Dedicated?
- Keys: we need to confirm KMS options — customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed, and whether HSM-backed keys are available for EU residency customers.

I've attached our partially completed vendor questionnaire — it highlights a few SIG entries we need more detail on (notably CAIQ 3.2.1 and 4.1.4).

For the timeline: 12/15 DPA sign looks tight but do-able if we run the evidence sprint the week of 11/29 and legal redlines by 12/06. Can Redwood commit to the evidence sprint dates?

Thanks —
Marta Lopez
Head of Infrastructure Security | FinStream
[Attachment: finstream-questionnaire-partial.xlsx]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finstream.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & close cadence — SIG/CAIQ, SOC 2 evidence, DPA retention options

Marta —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the questionnaire. Quick answers inline and a proposed compromise that should keep us on the 12/15 target if we hit the milestones below.

On retention and embeddings:
- Logs: we can accept a 180 -> 90 compromise: default hosted logs retention 180d, but we will build a short-path retention policy (90d) for FinStream in the Hosted tenant configuration with an attestation of deletion and audit log showing purge events. Owner: marcus.lin (engineering + ops).
- Embeddings: default hosted offering stores embeddings 365d. For FinStream we can offer 90d embeddings if they accept the following mitigations: pseudonymization (salted hashing of metadata), and an optional export prior to deletion. This will be a minor engineering configuration and can be scoped into the evidence sprint. Owner: kimberly.park + eng.

On KMS/HSM:
- We support Redwood-managed KMS by default. Customer-managed keys (BYOK) are available for Dedicated and Private deployments; HSM-backed export controls are available for EU-residency customers via our Private offering. We'll document the config options in the DPA appendix. Owner: jonas.weber.

SIG/CAIQ items:
- We'll prioritize CAIQ 3.2.1 and 4.1.4 in the evidence sprint and prepare narratives for the SOC 2 controls that map to them. Action: kimberly — deliver narratives by 11/18 EOD (as noted).

Proposed updated milestone sprint (compressed):
- 11/18 — Redwood delivers completed SIG/CAIQ matrix + DPA v3 with appendix on KMS options (in flight).
- 11/29 — Evidence sprint kickoff (3 half-day sessions) to walk through remaining CAIQ items.
- 12/06 — FinStream legal provides final redlines on DPA.
- 12/15 — Target DPA execution and MAP acceptance for staging.

If that looks good, I'll add these milestones to the Drive MAP and raise a short agenda for the evidence sprint (we'll include control owners and 2 engineers from our infra team).

On the questionnaire: thanks — we'll annotate the sheet and return with fill-ins for the flagged CAIQ items by tomorrow.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
